$comment: Liveness register (EDR 20261109-liveness-gate; checked by build/liveness/liveness.ts in workflow-lint). `entry`: declarations a host calls, which are live and make what they reach live. `exempt`: exported values nothing that runs reaches, each naming the consumer that uses it (it must exist and use the symbol in code) or `consumer: null` with the reason (printed on every run); a subject is exempted at most once. `removed`: tombstones for exemptions removed on purpose; re-adding one fails unless the tombstone says `restored` and why, and the list is append-only against the base register. `subjects`: everything that only matters if something runs it (scheduled and dispatch-only workflows, test hooks, fixtures, test extensions), each with what runs it and evidence it ran: a GitHub Actions `run` (verified in CI; the only kind a workflow subject accepts, and only of that workflow), a `ci` mark its runner records in the named job, or a `record` in a doc that names the subject id.
